name: UIW World Championship
epitaph: Announced for a 30-man battle royal at UIW's planned September 1997 Championship Weekend, then again for an October 1 Championship Coronation after the September date fell through; no result of either survives in this collection's own holdings.
notes: UIW's own September and October 1997 announcements (promotions/uiw/archive/).

name: UIW World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Billed for a first-round tournament at UIW's planned Championship Weekend and again at its October relaunch, with a final scheduled for 18 October 1997 at Madison Square Garden; no result survives in this collection's own holdings.
notes: UIW's own September and October 1997 announcements (promotions/uiw/archive/).

name: UIW North American Championship
epitaph: Billed for the loser's slot out of UIW's planned Championship Weekend battle royal, then re-announced as its own October tournament with a Madison Square Garden final; no result survives in this collection's own holdings.
notes: UIW's own September and October 1997 announcements (promotions/uiw/archive/).
